before: A suggested link's edges carried the insertion around it, so another person's words typed before the link joined the insertion's card live and had a card of their own after a checkpoint. A suggestion inside a text box whose object no longer showed kept a card, though the saved file has no such text box. After a checkpoint, a move that another suggestion's words split into two ranges kept two ranges once those words were rejected. A prompt's units that content filled read as shown in isOrderedItemHidden, so a host counted a suggestion on them before a checkpoint and not after. A suggested paragraph property the paragraph already had made a suggestion and a card, which no Word file holds; a section press that changed nothing did the same. After a checkpoint, a section's change record lost the default values the file stated in its old values, and a reject of a section change wrote the file's own section live but Word's restore after a checkpoint. A format suggested on a control's prompt, kept in the glossary while content filled the control, came back with its change record whatever its decision once a decision emptied the control after a reopen or a checkpoint, and a reopened Word file had no suggestion for it. A new column's cells or a new table inside another person's pending new row did not carry that row's insertion. A file move range whose words a direct deletion took out stayed after a decision on the move once folded, and a takeover inside a text box was lost at the second checkpoint. A suggestion read from a checkpoint or a Word file and taken back by its author came back at the next checkpoint when nothing else in its paragraph or block was labelled: compose wrote the loaded paragraph again, with the file's change record. A field whose result was a link (a one-row table of contents) loaded as one unit with the link's runs, so a reopen wrote them outside the link and dropped the suggestions inside it. A suggested row deletion over a cell with a change of its own wrote a cell with both w:cellIns and w:cellDel. Taking back an Enter that split a link, with another person's words at the first part's end, left one of the split's close items, and compose failed. A page field the room put inside another field's result, in that field's paragraph, was a unit with a card live and markers with no card after a reopen. A row height or a cell alignment suggested in the author's own new row or table was a suggestion of its own, written in Word's form for a row with no record (a row anchor and a grid record), so a checkpoint read three records back, and the alignment was lost. A suggested table press took over another person's records elsewhere in the table. A grid record names no author, so a checkpoint read it as a suggestion of nobody.
after: Card reads pass over a link's edges, as Word and the editor mark only a link's words, and leave out a text box whose object went, as they leave out a note whose references show nowhere. Compose draws two ranges of one file move that nothing drawn separates as one range. Cards and exported files are the same live and after a checkpoint. isOrderedItemHidden also hides a prompt's units while content fills the control, as the cards do. A paragraph or section press the engine's write leaves as it shows makes no record. A file's standing section record gives the old values of the writes over it, and a rejected section write leaves the section as Word and the engine restore it. A load reads a glossary prompt's change records as suggestions, and compose gives each record of a restored prompt the engine's accept or reject by its decision. New cells and tables take the labels of the row or paragraph they go into, as a paste does. Compose passes over a file move range with nothing drawn inside, and draws a text box whose story holds a takeover from its story. A load marks each item the file labelled, so compose draws its paragraph and blocks from the items, also after a take-back. A field whose result is a link loads as its markers and its result, as the room holds it. A suggested row deletion over a cell with a change of its own is refused, as the engine's tracked row deletion refuses it. Taking back an Enter takes back all of its split's close and open items, so one link stays. The room refuses a new field there, as no reopen reads it as one. A table press in the author's own new row or table is part of that insertion, with no change record, as the engine writes it. A table press records only the parts of the table the engine's op wrote, and the author's own pending records it joins. A checkpoint lists a grid record's w:id under its suggestion, and a load reads it as that suggestion's.
reason: The Yjs document format, the ordered protocol and the checkpoint manifest do not change; a checkpoint lists one more w:id for a suggestion with a grid record, which an earlier reader leaves unread, as before. Cards are read from the room's state with the same code on every copy, and every copy of a room runs the same code version. Ordered rooms are not deployed yet.
